# DreamTeam — AI Video Production

> DreamTeam is an AI video production company that creates high-impact, AI-generated video for brands and businesses: TV and social media ads, product videos, brand mascots, explainer/tutorial videos, AI avatars, and fully animated scenes. Based in Sofia, Bulgaria, serving clients in Bulgaria and worldwide. Website: https://dreamteam.video

DreamTeam ("Дрийм Тийм") produces advertising and brand video end to end using artificial intelligence — scripting, scene generation, editing, effects, and delivery. We place products and services in environments that are hard or expensive to film traditionally, tell stories with AI avatars, and deliver fast at a more accessible production cost than conventional shoots.

- Languages: Bulgarian (български) and English.
- Markets served: Bulgaria (България) and global / worldwide clients.
- Best for: brands and businesses that want video ads, product videos, social-media content (TikTok, Instagram/Reels, YouTube), corporate video, and AI avatars.

## Services

- **AI Video Production** — AI videos for TV ads, social media campaigns (TikTok, Instagram/Reels, YouTube), tutorials, internal communications, product videos, and stories with AI avatars in unique settings.
  - Bulgarian: AI видео продукция, рекламни видеа с изкуствен интелект, видео реклами за бизнес, продуктови видеа, корпоративно видео, видео за социални мрежи, AI аватари.
- **AI Brand Mascots** — animated AI mascot characters that represent and promote a brand.
  - Bulgarian: AI талисмани / маскоти за бранд.
- **AI Images** — AI-generated stills and visuals for campaigns and product presentation.
  - Bulgarian: AI изображения, генериране на изображения с изкуствен интелект.
- **AI Automation** — automated content and production pipelines.
  - Bulgarian: AI автоматизация на съдържание.
- **Training** — AI video training for individuals and teams / companies.
  - Bulgarian: обучения за създаване на видео с изкуствен интелект — индивидуални и корпоративни.

## How we work

1. **Request a quote** — share your project; we scope the timeline and requirements together.
2. **Receive your quote** — a tailored offer to review.
3. **Production** — we generate the scenes for your video with your continuous feedback.
4. **Editing & delivery** — editing, effects, transitions, and final delivery.

## Why DreamTeam

- Unique settings traditional filming can't easily reach (product scenes, AI avatars, hard-to-shoot environments).
- More accessible pricing — no film crews, extras, or props — a high-end look at a lower production cost.
- Fast turnaround, custom scripts, and experience across TV, social, product, and corporate video.

## Резюме на български

DreamTeam е компания за **AI видео продукция** в България. Създаваме **рекламни видеа с изкуствен интелект** за брандове и бизнеси — видео реклами за телевизия и социални мрежи (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube), **продуктови видеа**, **корпоративно видео**, **AI аватари**, **AI талисмани**, обяснителни видеа и анимации. Предлагаме и **обучения за създаване на видео с изкуствен интелект**. Работим по поръчка, с бързи срокове и достъпни цени, и обслужваме клиенти в България и по света. Сайт: https://dreamteam.video, имейл: info@dreamteam.technology
